description: This file defines the 'Sort' class that implements sorting functionalities such as SORT and SORTBY for a spreadsheet calculation library. It provides methods to sort arrays or ranges, handle multi-level sorting, and process sort vectors in a way that mimics Excel's behavior.

classes.name: Sort
classes.description: Class implementing sorting functions for spreadsheet calculations, including multi-level sorting capabilities.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs sorting on an array or range, supporting multi-level sorting, ascending/descending options, and sorting by row or column.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Sorts an array or range based on multiple criteria, with flexible arguments for each sort level.

methods.name: enumerateArrayKeys
methods.description: Reindexes the array, ensuring all sub-arrays are numeric indexed.

methods.name: validateScalarArgumentsForSort
methods.description: Validates that sort index and order arguments are scalars and within valid ranges.

methods.name: validateSortVector
methods.description: Validates a sort vector for correct type and size.

methods.name: validateSortOrder
methods.description: Validates that the sort order is either ascending or descending.

methods.name: validateArrayArgumentsForSort
methods.description: Validates the array arguments for multi-level sorting.

methods.name: prepareSortVectorValues
methods.description: Prepares individual sort vector values for comparison, handling booleans and string case-insensitivity.

methods.name: processSortBy
methods.description: Processes sorting based on multiple sort vectors and criteria.

methods.name: sortByRow
methods.description: Sorts an array by row based on provided sort indices and order.

methods.name: sortByColumn
methods.description: Sorts an array by column based on provided sort indices and order.

methods.name: buildVectorForSort
methods.description: Builds a sort vector for multi-level sorting.

methods.name: executeVectorSortQuery
methods.description: Executes the vector sorting using PHP's array_multisort, maintaining stability with a PHP version patch.

methods.name: sortLookupArrayFromVector
methods.description: Reorders the original array according to the sorted vector.

methods.name: applyPHP7Patch
methods.description: Adds stability to sorting in PHP 7 by adding an index-based tie-breaker.
